title: AI Talking Snowboarding
subtitle: This Episode Is All About Carving

scenes.heading: What Is Carving?
scenes.body: "It's like drawing a line in the snow with your whole body. Pure flow state."
scenes.highlight: drawing a line in the snow

features.title: The Fear
features.description: Everyone leans back because they're scared of the fall line

features.title: The Fix
features.description: Commit forward — drive the front knee over the toe edge

features.title: Trust It
features.description: Let the board do the work

scenes.leftBody: Pressure on the front foot. Drive your knee forward over the toe edge. The board turns naturally when you commit.
scenes.rightBody: All hips. Push your hips into the hill. Show your back to the valley. Once it clicks, the edge bites.

scenes.heading: The Cue That Changes Everything
scenes.highlight: Show your back to the valley

features.title: More Speed
features.description: More edge hold — the board grips harder

features.title: Slow Carves
features.description: Actually wash out easier — counterintuitive but true

features.title: Physics
features.description: The board is designed to turn when you tilt it. Trust the edge.

features.title: Garlands
features.description: Half turns across the slope — feel edge engagement over and over

features.title: Film Yourself
features.description: You think you're leaning forward but the camera never lies

features.title: Repeat
features.description: Simple but effective — trust the process

scenes.heading: Final Word
scenes.body: "Trust the edge. The board is designed to turn when you tilt it. Let physics do the thing."
